acceptance.scope: fixed engineering gates; NOT calibrated accuracy or insertion acceptance

jam_detection.action: stop downward target; retract to preinsert safe height; save actual failure

control.alignment_budget_basis: 10mm full-path clearance>=.35mm: .10mm XY +27mm*sin(.15deg)=.071mm + yaw .2deg envelope .025mm <.35mm; release penetration50um and stability200um/1deg/3s unchanged

demo_release.native_velocity_policy: retain and flag discrepancy; finite check and actual pose motion are hard gates; speed mismatch alone does not veto opening

gripper.method: contact_latched uses measured bilateral joint position minus mg/(2*combined_dynamic_friction)*safety/finger_kp; no gain or force-limit change

robot.initial_joint_basis: Env_v1 arm_plan_01 seed1; sampled full11-link input triangle pathcheck, actual dynamics still required

scene.instrument_yaw_policy: explicit video-informed hypothesis with lateral rack offset; not automatic pointing

adapter.geometry: original CAD mesh3; no engineering adapter

task.instruction: Physically load the 10mm XY size-hypothesis cuvette from fixed white rack slot A1 into unchanged original internal seat candidate_far_hinge, transfer support, release, retreat and leave stable for3seconds.

randomization.scope: only execute after geometry valid and one full task succeeds; keep whole assemblies together

vessel.dimension_source: Registered XY size hypothesis; not a real measured cuvette dimension
vessel.xy_scale_basis: Legacy original14.85mm CAD helper only; selected USD already derived; no second scale applied
vessel.mass_distribution_assumption: Uniform closed visual material volume, cavity excluded; fixed total mass means numerical density varies; no constant-density claim

asset_selection.validation_scope: Registered USD/source/sidecar hashes and atomic geometric/mass/contact metadata; independent geometry, cooked collision and physical execution still required
